events.title: Ralph Waldo Emerson is born
events.description: The future poet, essayist and lecturer was born in Boston, Massachusetts. He grew up to become one of America's most influential thinkers.
events.significance: Emerson led the Transcendentalist movement. His essays on self-reliance and individualism shaped American literature and philosophy.

events.title: The May Revolution culminates in Buenos Aires
events.description: A week of revolutionary events in Buenos Aires ended on this day. Local leaders replaced the Spanish-appointed viceroy with a locally formed governing council.
events.significance: Argentines mark May 25 as a patriotic holiday. The revolution is seen as the first step toward independence from Spain.

events.title: The Organisation of African Unity is founded
events.description: Leaders of 32 independent African nations met in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, and formed a continental alliance.
events.significance: The organisation promoted decolonisation and opposed white minority rule in Africa. It later became the African Union, and the date is still celebrated as Africa Day.

events.title: Star Wars opens in theaters
events.description: George Lucas's space opera reached U.S. cinemas and quickly became a runaway hit.
events.significance: The film transformed blockbuster filmmaking, special effects and movie merchandising. It launched one of the most successful franchises in entertainment history.
